calculation.taxableCompensationWarning: Pennsylvania taxable compensation is not always federal W-2 Box 1; apply the official additions and subtractions before multiplying by the rate.

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: Withhold from resident compensation for services within or outside Pennsylvania when the employer is subject to Pennsylvania withholding requirements.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentOutsideStateAdjustment: If the resident works wholly in another income-tax state and the employer withholds that state's tax, Pennsylvania withholding is not required on that wholly out-of-state compensation; mixed-location compensation retains Pennsylvania withholding on Pennsylvania services.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Withhold from Pennsylvania-source services unless the employee qualifies under a reciprocal agreement or another controlling exemption.
residencyAndWorkRules.mixedNonresidentAllocation: Only compensation for services within Pennsylvania is subject to Pennsylvania withholding.
reciprocityRequirements: Employer withholds and remits the reciprocal resident state's income tax
residencyAndWorkRules.reciprocityOhioException: A Pennsylvania-resident 20-percent shareholder-employee of an Ohio S corporation is outside the Ohio agreement for remuneration for Ohio services.
specialExclusions: Domestic servants outside federal employee treatment
Newspaper carriers and vendors under 18 and federal statutory employees
Federally protected interstate transportation workers and seamen

paymentSchedules.due: Last day of April, July, October, and January
Within three banking days after semimonthly period closes
Wednesday after Wed-Fri pay dates; Friday after Sat-Tue pay dates

quarterlyReturn.due: Last day of April, July, October, and January

earnedIncomeTax.applicability: Employers with Pennsylvania worksites, including homes of home-based employees, must withhold local EIT.
earnedIncomeTax.philadelphiaException: Employees subject to the Sterling Act wage tax are outside the ordinary Act 32 branch to that extent.
earnedIncomeTax.remittance: Workplace tax collector within 30 days after quarter unless an approved multi-location monthly electronic consolidation applies.

localServicesTax.rateOver10: Prorate across employer payroll periods and round each share down to cents.
localServicesTax.rateAtMost10: May collect as a lump sum.
concurrentEmploymentPriority: Employment nearest in miles to home
